name: Sky, Air Traffic
description: Flights currently overhead at your location via OpenSky Network (free, no key). Radar plus the nearest N flights with callsign, altitude, speed, distance, and the route (SYD→MEL) or registration country.

cell_options.name: show_route
cell_options.label: Show route (departure→arrival)
cell_options.help: Looks each callsign up on adsbdb.com and shows SYD→MEL in place of the registration country. Scheduled flights only; private aircraft keep the country.
